title: Join us in NYC for AI DevCon Fall 2026
description:
Get 15% off with code YT15: https://tessl.co/4ox

Your agent setup works. It works on your machine, for you, and nowhere else on the team. Getting an agent to write code isn't the hard part anymore. Getting a whole team doing it the same way, in one codebase, without grinding review to a halt, is.

AI Native DevCon NYC is three days on that problem. November 2 to 4, 2026, at Industry City in Brooklyn.

November 2 is hands-on workshops. November 3 and 4 are talks from people running agents in production: harness engineering, agent enablement, software factories, and what it actually takes to take AI-native development from one developer to a whole team.

AI Native DevCon London sold out this June. 40+ talks, speakers from Anthropic, OpenAI, Netlify, and GitHub, and a room of engineering leads comparing notes instead of trading predictions. New York is bigger.

Who it's for: developers directing the agents, the engineers building the loops, the leads rolling it out across teams, and the people setting the strategy.

TICKETS Early-bird pricing is open for a limited window. All-access covers the workshop day plus both conference days. Conference-only covers November 3 and 4. Teams of 5 or more get discounted pricing.

Book at https://aidevcon.io

The AI Native Dev podcast: https://ainativedev.com

#AINativeDev #AgenticCoding #DevCon
